ValidationRule.description: #21305 At stage 5/6/7 we should restrict users from Editing the First Bill Date #20656- Added bypass logic to edit First bill date in late stage
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
ISCHANGED( IM_Booked_Date__c ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, '5 - Signed/PO in'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '6 - Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, '7 - Closed')),
NOT(ISPICKVAL( PRIORVALUE(StageName), '4 - Negotiate')),
$Profile.Name <> 'System Administrator', $Profile.Name <> 'IM_Custom Sys Admin',
NOT($Permission.Edit_FBD_in_Late_Stage_Opp), NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission)
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You cannot update the First Bill Date once an Opportunity has been Won. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
